thread:
marta: Auditor asked for traceability between RBAC changes and KMS key usage for last quarter. Need exact query + evidence they can consume. SOC2 CC6 ask.

samir: Can we export CloudTrail KMS events? CloudTrail has KMSDecrypt/KMSGenerateDataKey events. Need IAM policy diffs for the same window.

jess: We store CloudTrail in s3://redwood-cloudtrail-prod/ and have Athena tables. Also k8s audit logs in EFK. We can join if we export a slice.

marta: Would auditor accept csv exports plus a manifest with SHA256 hashes? They want principal_id mapping but not raw emails.

auditor-bot: AUDIT REQUEST #9023: Provide mapping for RBAC role changes (k8s ClusterRoleBinding create/update) to KMS decrypt/generate events for 2025-10-01..2025-12-31. Include control mapping to SOC 2 CC6 and ISO A.9.

liam: We keep k8s audit logs in EFK for 90 days, so need to pull historical snapshots. Proposed approach:
1) export admission events for rolebinding create/update
2) export CloudTrail KMS events
3) join on source IP + time window +/-2min
4) include infra repo commit hashes for any IaC that changed bindings

samir: I'll script export. Example Athena query:
```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey')
AND eventTime BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31';
```
Deliverables: rbac_events.csv, kms_events.csv, joinable_keys.csv, README.md (queries + join logic), signed_manifest.txt (SHA256s).

marta: Also include PR links for RBAC reviews and the approvers list. Auditor expects evidence of review workflow.

jess: Note: differentiate GenerateDataKey (encryption) vs Decrypt (decryption). Auditor asked for decryption counts by role — we'll aggregate by mapped role IDs.

liam: We will redact emails -> provide mapping file encrypted with customer KMS, share decryption key via our secure channel. No PII in main package.

marta: Timeline: auditor wants initial package by EOD Friday.

samir: :thumbsup: Draft exports by tomorrow EOD. I'll stage artifacts at s3://redwood-audit-temp/9023/ and set object ACL to audit-only.

jess: Add Splunk snapshot for correlated alerts — saw 2 decrypt spikes on 2025-11-17 that are part of our vuln triage notes.

ops-ct: Noted. Opening incident ticket INC-2025-1147 and linking audit artifacts + triage notes.

auditor-bot: AUDIT BOT: Reminder to include control mapping doc linking CloudTrail events to SOC 2 CC6/ISO A.9, and note on retention policy.

marta: I'll draft the control mapping doc and include PR link. Ping if anyone is blocked.

liam: Will update this thread when uploads complete and share proof hashes.
